重點文章.期刊: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association

【研究背景】Belimumab, a monoclonal antibody targeting B lymphocyte stimulator, has shown benefits in systemic lupus erythematosus and lupus nephritis, but its role in IgA nephropathy (IgAN) remains unclear. We evaluated the effectiveness and safety of belimumab in IgAN.

【研究方法】This retrospective cohort study included biopsy-proven IgAN patients at Tongji Hospital, China (July 2020-June 2024). Sixty-nine patients treated with belimumab were compared with 137 propensity score-matched controls receiving standard therapy.

【主要結果】Among 206 patients with IgAN (median age 37 years, baseline estimated glomerular filtration rate 79 ml/min/1.73 m², proteinuria 1.1 g/24 h), 173 (84%) achieved proteinuria remission within 12 months.

【結論】Belimumab treatment was associated with higher proteinuria remission rates in patients with IgAN, without an increased incidence of common adverse events. These findings suggest that belimumab may represent a superior therapeutic approach for IgAN in real-world clinical practice.

結構化摘要.背景: AND HYPOTHESIS: Primary membranous nephropathy (MN) and diabetes mellitus (DM) are common comorbidities, yet the impact of DM on the response to anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody therapy in MN remains unclear. We hypothesized that despite comparable B-cell depletion, MN patients with comorbid DM would exhibit a reduced treatment response compared to nondiabetic MN patients.
結構化摘要.方法: In this retrospective cohort study, we included adults with primary MN who received at least one complete course of anti-CD20 antibody therapy. Propensity score matching (1:2) was applied based on age, sex, baseline estimated glomerular filtration rate, urinary protein, and PLA2R antibody status. The primary outcome was remission (complete or partial) of proteinuria at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months. Secondary outcomes included immunological remission, B-cell depletion, and changes in renal parameters.
結構化摘要.結果: After matching, 207 patients were included (72 MN + DM, 135 MN). 結構化摘要.結論: Despite equivalent B-cell depletion, MN with DM patients show a reduced response to anti-CD20 antibody therapy relative to nondiabetic patients, underscoring that tight glycemic control, early supplementary anti-CD20 dosing for poor response, and combined immunosuppressive regimens may enhance their clinical outcomes.
